subtitle: House, BBQ, and your last 30th
joinUsParagraph: On May 9th, you're celebrating your last 30th birthday at mine - at least as a guest, for quite some time. We'll do what the RIVI does best: start easy, eat well, refill glasses, and see how far the evening wants to go. We begin at home, and if the energy is still there later on, the city is welcome to make a guest appearance.
practicalInfoParagraph: A few sleeping spots are available. If you're coming from Lippstadt, heading back later is also totally fine. So yes, the ending stays flexible - officially we're on from 5 PM to 11 PM, unofficially the vibe will decide the rest.
soundsParagraph: Expect relaxed house with enough groove for long conversations, spontaneous kitchen dance floors, and that moment when everyone realizes it got late a lot faster than planned.
foodParagraph: The grill will not just be there for decoration: there will be salads, burgers, and bratwurst, so please arrive appropriately hungry.
drinksParagraph: Drinks will of course be cold, stocked, and ready for a proper evening. If at some point the big question becomes whether water, wine, or one last nightcap is the right move, we will find an excellent answer together.
lookingForward: Looking forward to having you - and to finally being the one watching everyone else deal with their age for a change. Welcome to my side.
homepageSubtitle: Your last 30th birthday. For a while.
homepageWelcome: You won't be getting this invitation again anytime soon.
storyIntro: I'm the youngest. You know this. Which means this evening is, for many of you, the last 30th birthday you will ever attend as a guest. No drama - but maybe reason enough to take it seriously.
storyRIVI: RIVI remains what it has always been: Richard plus Ivonne, a running joke with its own address, and the kind of place where 'we'll only stop by for a bit' rarely stays true for long.
storyVienna: The theme is set: your last 30th birthday. Unofficially that means grill on, drinks cold, house on the speakers - and the door open for everyone who wants to slide into this new decade together with me.
storyDusseldorf: We start on Saturday, May 9th 2026, from 5 PM at Paulusplatz in Dusseldorf and see together whether the night stays cozy at ours or eventually drifts into the city.
storyConclusion: So: show up ready to celebrate, enjoy your personal last 30th, and let's spend this evening the way it deserves - relaxed, warm, and with the full awareness that this particular occasion doesn't come around twice.
upcomingEventsDescription: Your last 30th birthday - at least as a guest. Grilled food, salads, burgers, bratwurst, drinks, and house vibes at RIVI on Paulusplatz.
